D49·nt15 — 2026-11-14
chose: sofar-core owns plain `find <seed> [--hops N] [--initiative S] [--root D]`. boot.ts adds `find` to CORE_COMMANDS. The core returns exit 64, before writing any byte, for styled output (the colour ladder says colour), --compose, --budget, --since, --help, a non-decimal --hops, a second positional and any other flag. The core ports the whole reach tier: reading reach.json + reach-terms.json (the linked-context D27 format), the lazy-tail catch-up, and persisting at REACH_LAZY_TAIL. It persists byte-identical files so either implementation can read the other's.
over: Porting find whole (styled + --compose) now, or porting only the read and returning 64 whenever reach is stale
because: Agents run find from non-TTY shells, so plain output is the hot shape. Styled output is human-frequency and --compose also needs the links-tier packet renderer, so both can follow once parity is proven. Returning 64 on a stale reach would hand most mid-session finds back to TypeScript, because hooks append on every edit (linked-context D26). The core already has index_pass, index_tail and lexicon, so the reducer is a small port. This is a new dispatched shape under D15, D16 and D21. The exit-64 contract is unchanged.
